reviews.review: Its a really great game, atleast in my opinion. You play as ultramarine smurf boi captain dude titus, who need to save some planet from orks who're tryna' still this big robot thingy. Im at the part where you get a power-core lantern looking thing and  i /think/  i fought the warboss for the first time

Blasting hundreds of orcs into pieces is undeniably fun. The balance between the melee combat and gunplay is wonderful and helps to give the player options in their approach to the oncoming enemies. Furthermore, the constant introduction of new melee weapons, guns, and enemies prevents the gameplay loop from becoming stale.

While the lore behind the different clans and enemies is well fleshed out, the actual storyline that is told is dry. The main squad of characters doesn't have interesting personalities or motivations. While they do feel grounded and appropriate for the setting, they simply lack any uniqueness. Yet, the story does progress at a favorable pace and is adequate.

If you’d like to experience being a sci-fi military trooper of the future ripping orcs into pieces then Space Marine definitely delivers. Just don’t expect anything great outside of the combat.
They increase the price of the game after 10 years to 60 dollars like it was released yesterday.Branded it as anniversary edition.

Space Marine manages to be perfectly serviceable for an action game, if you can catch it on sale or in a bundle, go for it, it's  shrink-wrapped fun.

Is it a thought provoking story about the nature of humanity? No, it's about being a Space Marine
Is it a heavily detailed action-rpg with deep mechanics and combat system? No, just mash the buttons and bring justice to the enemies of mankind.
Is it a perfect game? No, it's flawed in many ways (the weapon system is a bit funky, some combats take forever, those ♥♥♥♥♥♥♥ rocket launching asshats).

However, is it fun?
Yes, it's a game that the 40K franchise should make more of: Pure Action games about complete violence and brining justice to the enemies of mankind (or Eldarkind, or Necronkind, or Xkind really).

Play it, have fun.

Got this for free but I bought this on console before. The game makes you feel like a badass spacemarine. Play on the easiest difficulty to feel like a primarch or play on hardest to feel the true 40k life.
